bullets.text: duck at shusshaka-ji. the cliff leans out to look at the plain, so the duck did too. 🗻
today's pocket line: how you do anything is how you do everything. the dishes heard that and got nervous.
overcast again. the clouds have been drafting the same grey email for three days.
rereading old one-line journal entries. past me was very confident about strange things.
steady. the kind of tired that still laces its shoes.
